<description>
This is a small linter to reject confusingly named RPC arg names or RPC result fields. Generally, such names should be `snake_case`. Otherwise, there are [bugs and confusion](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35317#issue-4473659957).

For now, write a C++20 `consteval` linter that still accepts `MiXed_cAse`. In the future, it can be made stricter.
</description>

<commits>
fa0794bb62 rpc: Check named args names at compile time

fabdf113d3 rpc: Check result field names at compile time

This also requires disabling modernize-use-emplace for now, because
clang-tidy will incorrectly suggest to use emplace, which will not work
with the consteval name.

Disabling should be fine, because moves are typically cheap and in-place
construction is not really needed.
</commits>
